how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-09-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:79974:title: Wet Job
rows.quest:79974:details:0:
Always like to keep a reserve stash nearby in the off chance I've got to flee in a hurry.

The face of this mountainside is so beautiful you might say it was carved from the waterfalls of time.
That's the eagles nest, that's what you're looking for.
rows.quest:79975:title: Eagle's Fist
rows.quest:79975:details:0:
You find a carefully folded letter inside of the toolbox. Imagining a voice speaking, you read: "From here, with the right tools, you call the shots. Great place to launch a parachute glider.

My loyalty to the Eagle and Fist requires distance in order to serve them best. This barricade has had better days, like the Old Kingdoms it once defended, but I'll never abandon it."
rows.quest:79975:completion:0: A campfire is newly fed with wood, but signs of a quick departure are evident.
rows.quest:79976:title: This Must Be The Place
rows.quest:79976:details:0:
"So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...
rows.quest:79976:completion:0: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.
rows.quest:79980:title: Scramble
rows.quest:79980:details:0: Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going.
rows.quest:79980:completion:0: You pull a messenger bag out of the ground. Stuffed in with the supplies is a dirty parchment.

rows.quest:7931:progress:0: Step right up, step right up! If you have tickets from the Darkmoon Faire you'd like redeemed, then just say so! You can redeem tickets in various denominations for wondrous and fantastic prizes. Don't be shy, give it a try!
rows.quest:7931:completion:0: Here you go, here you go! A prize fit for a ⟦1⟧! Congratulations to you, my friend!⟦2⟧⟦3⟧If you have more tickets you'd like to turn in, then please let me know! For as long as the Darkmoon Faire is here, I'll redeem your tickets.

rows.quest:96394:title: The Restless Dead
rows.quest:96394:obj:0: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions, 10 Tormented Souls and put the spirit of Anvilmar to rest.
rows.quest:96394:details:0: Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.
rows.quest:96394:details:1: Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
rows.quest:96394:progress:0: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
rows.quest:96403:title: Important Heirlooms
rows.quest:96403:obj:0: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms from the Hall of Thanes.
rows.quest:96403:details:0: You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.
rows.quest:96403:details:1: I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.
rows.quest:96403:details:2: I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
rows.quest:96403:progress:0: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>

rows.quest:95250:title: Abominable Creatures
rows.quest:95250:obj:0: Collect the ⟦E15⟧ in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
rows.quest:95250:details:0: What do you want, ? Can't you see there is a war to be won?
rows.quest:95250:details:1: My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.
rows.quest:95250:details:2: I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

rows.quest:91859:title: A Curious Pair
rows.quest:91859:obj:0: Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious ⟦E17⟧ travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.
rows.quest:91859:details:0: Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the ⟦E17⟧, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.
rows.quest:91859:details:1: Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
rows.quest:91860:title: A Grim Fate
rows.quest:91860:obj:0: Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the ⟦E17⟧ traveling party.
rows.quest:91860:details:0: Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.
rows.quest:91860:details:1: If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, its a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.
rows.quest:91860:details:2: I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
